docs.summary: [EnableIf("memberName")] - greys the field out (visible, not editable) while the named bool member is false. Interaction is blocked via BeginReadOnly, and the field is drawn under a faded theme so the disabled state is visually obvious.

Draw a stretch of UI as disabled: blocks interaction (BeginReadOnly) and renders it under the faded theme so the state is visually obvious. Dispose the scope to restore. Reusable by any editor UI that wants the same look as [EnableIf].

docs.summary: Called after the field is drawn. Pairs with every [`OnBeforeDraw`](#api~Prowl.Editor.GUI.EnableIfAttributeHandler~OnBeforeDraw) that returned true, even when a later handler skips the field, so a scope opened there can always be closed.
